subject: Important Update: Meeting Rescheduled
body: Dear Team, I hope this message finds you well. Due to unforeseen circumstances, the weekly team meeting scheduled for tomorrow at 10 AM has been rescheduled to Thursday at the same time. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding. Please make the necessary adjustments to your calendars. Thank you for your attention to this matter. Best regards, [Your Name]
